summary_rationale: UnitedHealth Group retains an unmatched dual-engine U.S. healthcare moat combining UnitedHealthcare's 48.3M-member insurance network with Optum's $270B+ health-services, pharmacy, and analytics platform, generating >1.29x CFO-to-net-income conversion across a 10-year cycle. However, 2025 exposed severe margin vulnerability (-41% EBIT to $19.0B, Optum Health operating loss of $(278)M, MCR spike to 88.9%) alongside active DOJ Medicare Advantage billing investigations, FTC PBM settlements, and $131.0B in goodwill/intangibles. Strong 9M 2026 operational recovery (EBIT +27% YoY to $23.5B, Q3 MCR down to 88.4%, CFO $25.1B, and debt-to-capital declining toward 40%) supports a COMPOUNDER_PASS with PASS_WITH_WATCH pending DOJ resolution and sustained Optum Health margin normalization.
